titleEn: Elon Musk Briefs Universe Today & Media ahead of Revolutionary Falcon 9 Blastoff
titleZh: 埃隆·马斯克在革命性的猎鹰9号升空前向《今日宇宙》及媒体作简报
summaryEn: Pre-launch press briefing given by Musk in Cocoa Beach, Florida, on November 24, 2013, to a small group of reporters including Universe Today's Ken Kremer, on the eve of the first Florida flight of the upgraded Falcon 9 v1.1 with the SES-8 satellite — SpaceX's first commercial launch to geostationary transfer orbit.
summaryZh: 2013年11月24日，马斯克在佛罗里达州可可海滩向一小群记者作了发射前新闻简报，其中包括《今日宇宙》的肯·克雷默；当时正值搭载SES-8卫星的升级版猎鹰9号v1.1首次从佛罗里达州飞行的前夕——这是SpaceX首次执行飞往地球静止转移轨道的商业发射。

segments.textEn: Ken Kremer — Universe Today, November 25, 2013
segments.textZh: 肯·克雷默——《今日宇宙》，2013年11月25日

segments.textEn: CAPE CANAVERAL, FL — A new space era potentially dawns today, Nov. 25, with the planned maiden launch of the next generation SpaceX Falcon 9 commercial rocket from Cape Canaveral, FL, that could completely revolutionize how we access the high frontier and “rock the space industry to its core” by cutting cost and production times — if all goes well.
segments.textZh: 佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角——一个新的太空时代可能会在今天，即11月25日，随着下一代SpaceX猎鹰9号商业火箭按计划从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角首次发射而开启；如果一切顺利，它可能通过削减成本和生产时间，彻底革新我们进入太空前沿的方式，并“从根本上撼动航天业”。

segments.textEn: Just a day before liftoff, SpaceX founder and CEO Elon Musk personally briefed reporters including Universe Today on Sunday (Nov. 24) in Cocoa Beach, FL, nearby the firms Cape Canaveral launch facility about today’s (Nov. 25) upcoming maiden launch of the companies upgraded Falcon 9 rocket, saying it was “very important” for the future.
segments.textZh: 就在升空前1天，SpaceX创始人兼首席执行官埃隆·马斯克于周日（11月24日）在佛罗里达州可可海滩亲自向包括《今日宇宙》在内的记者作了简报，该地靠近该公司位于卡纳维拉尔角的发射设施；他介绍了该公司升级版猎鹰9号火箭即将在今天（11月25日）进行的首次发射，并称这对未来“非常重要”。

segments.textEn: “This launch is very important to the future of SpaceX. This is our toughest mission yet!” said Musk to a small group of reporters, including the author, gathered for Sunday’s exclusive pre-launch briefing.
segments.textZh: “此次发射对SpaceX的未来非常重要。这是我们迄今最艰难的任务！”马斯克对包括本文作者在内、为参加周日独家发射前简报而聚集的一小群记者说道。

segments.textEn: “Whether or not this launch is successful, I'm confident we will certainly make it on some subsequent launch,” said Musk at the Cocoa Beach meeting with the media.
segments.textZh: “无论此次发射是否成功，我相信我们肯定会在之后的某次发射中做到，”马斯克在可可海滩的媒体见面会上说道。

segments.textEn: The Falcon 9 liftoff from Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral, FL is scheduled for 5:37pm EST and will be webcast live by SpaceX for viewing at www.spacex.com/webcast
segments.textZh: 猎鹰9号定于美国东部标准时间下午5:37从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角40号发射台升空，SpaceX将在www.spacex.com/webcast进行网络直播。

segments.textEn: Today’s (Nov. 25) inaugural blastoff of the privately developed Falcon 9 rocket with the commercial SES-8 HDTV and telecommunications satellite is especially noteworthy because it also features SpaceX’s first ever launch of any satellite to a Geostationary Transfer Orbit (GTO).
segments.textZh: 今天（11月25日），这枚私人研制的猎鹰9号火箭将搭载商业SES-8高清电视和通信卫星首次升空；此次发射尤其值得关注，因为这也是SpaceX有史以来首次将任何卫星发射至地球静止转移轨道（GTO）。

segments.textEn: From the start, SpaceX designed the Falcon 9 rocket from a clean sheet aimed at radically reducing production and manufacturing costs and assembly times and thereby offer significantly lower launch price, says Musk.
segments.textZh: 马斯克表示，SpaceX从一开始就从零开始设计猎鹰9号火箭，目标是大幅降低生产和制造成本及组装时间，从而提供低得多的发射价格。

segments.textEn: “I don't want to tempt fate, but I think it's going to have a pretty significant impact on the world launch market and on the launch industry because our prices are the most competitive of any in the world,” Musk stated.
segments.textZh: “我不想冒险妄言，但我认为它将对全球发射市场和发射行业产生相当重大的影响，因为我们的价格比世界上任何其他公司的都更具竞争力，”马斯克表示。

segments.textEn: SES-8 also represents SpaceX’s first launch of a Falcon 9 carrying a commercial satellite to space from the Florida Space Coast.
segments.textZh: SES-8还代表着SpaceX首次从佛罗里达太空海岸发射搭载商业卫星进入太空的猎鹰9号。

segments.textEn: “This is really rocking the industry. Everybody has to look out,” said Martin Halliwell, SES chief technical officer, who joined Musk at Sunday’s meeting.
segments.textZh: “这确实正在撼动整个行业。所有人都必须当心，”SES首席技术官马丁·哈利韦尔说道，他与马斯克一同参加了周日的会面。

segments.textEn: The 3,138 kg (6,918 lbs) SES-8 satellite is a hybrid Ku- and Ka-band spacecraft that will provide TV and communications coverage for the South Asia and Asia Pacific regions.
segments.textZh: 重3,138千克（6,918磅）的SES-8卫星是一艘兼用Ku和Ka频段的航天器，将为南亚和亚太地区提供电视及通信覆盖。

segments.textEn: The SES-8 spacecrft was built by Orbital Sciences Corp and will be lofted to a 295 x 80,000 km geosynchronous transfer orbit inclined 20.75 degrees.
segments.textZh: SES-8航天器由轨道科学公司制造，将被送入一条295 × 80,000千米、倾角为20.75度的地球同步转移轨道。

segments.textEn: SpaceX has signed nearly 50 commercial and government launch contracts and thus already sports a very crowded launch manifest ahead of today’s Falcon 9 launch.
segments.textZh: SpaceX已签署近50份商业和政府发射合同，因此在今天的猎鹰9号发射之前就已经拥有一份非常拥挤的发射任务清单。

segments.textEn: All five launches of SpaceX’s Falcon 9 rocket from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Air Force Station were either test launches or flights to the International Space Station, under contract to NASA.
segments.textZh: SpaceX猎鹰9号火箭此前从卡纳维拉尔角空军基地40号航天发射场进行的全部5次发射，要么是试验发射，要么是根据与NASA签订的合同飞往国际空间站。

segments.textEn: The five Falcon 9 launches to date from the Florida Space Coast also featured the original, less powerful and shorter version of the booster and has a 100% success rate.
segments.textZh: 迄今从佛罗里达太空海岸进行的5次猎鹰9号发射，使用的也都是最初那款推力较小、长度较短的助推器，成功率为100%。

segments.textEn: This mighty new version of the Falcon 9 dubbed v1.1 is powered by a cluster of nine of SpaceX’s new Merlin 1D engines that are about 50% more powerful compared to the standard Merlin 1C engines. The nine Merlin 1D engines 1.3 million pounds of thrust at sea level that rises to 1.5 million pounds as the rocket climbs to orbit.
segments.textZh: 这款被称为v1.1的强大新版猎鹰9号，由9台SpaceX新型梅林1D发动机组成的发动机组提供动力；与标准梅林1C发动机相比，其推力高出约50%。这9台梅林1D发动机在海平面为130万磅推力，随着火箭爬升至轨道，增至150万磅。

segments.textEn: Therefore the upgraded Falcon 9 can boost a much heavier cargo load to the ISS, low Earth orbit, geostationary orbit and beyond.
segments.textZh: 因此，升级版猎鹰9号能够把重得多的货物送往国际空间站、近地轨道、地球静止轨道及更远的地方。

segments.textEn: The next generation Falcon 9 is a monster. It measures 224 feet tall and is 12 feet in diameter. That compares to 13 stories for the original Falcon 9.
segments.textZh: 下一代猎鹰9号是个庞然大物。它高224英尺，直径12英尺。相比之下，最初的猎鹰9号有13层楼高。

segments.textEn: The payload fairing for SES-8 is 17 feet in diameter.
segments.textZh: SES-8的有效载荷整流罩直径为17英尺。

segments.textEn: The Falcon 9/SES-8 launch window extends for 66 minutes until 6:43 p.m. EST. Weather outlook is 80% favorable at this time.
segments.textZh: 猎鹰9号/SES-8的发射窗口持续66分钟，直至美国东部标准时间下午6:43。目前天气适宜的概率为80%。

segments.textEn: SpaceX is planning a live webcast of the launch with commentary from SpaceX corporate headquarters in Hawthorne, CA.
segments.textZh: SpaceX计划对发射进行网络直播，并由SpaceX位于加利福尼亚州霍桑的公司总部提供解说。

segments.textEn: The broadcast will begin at approximately 5:00 p.m. EDT and include detailed discussions about the Falcon 9 rocket, launch and flight sequences as well as about the SES-8 satellite.
segments.textZh: 直播将于美国东部夏令时间下午5:00左右开始，内容包括对猎鹰9号火箭、发射和飞行程序以及SES-8卫星的详细讨论。
